summary: Comprehensive testing of Phishing Simulation MVP completed. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified the protected /phishing page loads correctly with campaign creation, employee targeting, template selection, and results dashboard. Public /phishing/simulation/:token training page loads and displays training content with report button functionality. Navigation to phishing page is available from both desktop sidebar and mobile navigation. Core auth/dashboard flows continue to work after phishing additions.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/phishing/templates correctly returns 3 phishing templates with required fields (id, name, category, difficulty, subject, preview_text, scenario, cta_label)
POST /api/phishing/campaigns correctly validates: name required, at least one employee required, valid template_id required
POST /api/phishing/campaigns with send_immediately=false creates draft campaign with status='draft'
POST /api/phishing/campaigns with send_immediately=true sends emails and updates status to 'sent', 'partially_sent', or 'failed' based on Resend delivery
GET /api/phishing/campaigns returns list with aggregated results (total_targets, delivered_count, opened_count, clicked_count, reported_count)
GET /api/phishing/campaigns/{id} returns recipient-level outcomes with all tracking fields
GET /api/phishing/simulations/{token} marks click timestamp and returns training content (red_flags, learning_points, scenario)
POST /api/phishing/simulations/{token}/report logs report action and returns confirmation
GET /api/phishing/track/open/{token} returns transparent GIF for email open tracking
Protected /phishing page has all required UI elements: hero panel, summary metrics, create campaign form, results dashboard
Public training page displays employee name, campaign name, red flags, learning points, and report button
Navigation to phishing available in both desktop sidebar and mobile navigation
Resend sandbox mode correctly handled - delivery failures show sanitized error messages without exposing recipient emails
seed_data_creation: Multiple test campaigns created during testing: TEST_Draft_Campaign_*, TEST_Send_Campaign_*, TEST_Detail_Campaign_*, Test Campaign from Playwright
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phishing simulation MVP is fully functional. All campaign creation, employee targeting, email template selection, tracked opens/clicks/reports, safe internal training landing page, and results dashboard with employee-level outcomes are working correctly. Resend is in sandbox mode so email delivery to unverified recipients will show 'failed' status with sanitized error message - this is expected behavior. The phishing navigation link is available in both desktop sidebar and mobile navigation.

Recipient-level outcome display (delivery, opened, clicked, reported status)
Red flags section with warning icons
